description: A class named 'jiraCommons' providing utility functions for interacting with Jira issues within a test tracking system. Includes methods for checking issue existence, parsing dates, building status and summary strings, and initializing default resolved statuses.

classes.name: jiraCommons
classes.description: Provides methods for issue verification, date formatting, string building for issue status and summary, and initialization of resolved statuses.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if a Jira issue with the given ID exists, verifying syntax and object retrieval.

methods.name: helperParseDate
methods.description: Parses a date string and formats it with localization, returning a string with due date info.

methods.name: buildStatusHTMLString
methods.description: Constructs a string representing the issue status, optionally decorated.

methods.name: buildSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Builds the issue summary string, appending the due date if available.

methods.name: initDefaultResolvedStatus
methods.description: Initializes an array of resolved statuses based on the provided domain, specifically 'Resolved' and 'Closed'.
